annual_report.name: Annual Report (Form LLC-50.1)
annual_report.due: before the first day of the LLC's anniversary month (statute; not re-read today)
annual_report.late_penalty: $100 late penalty; administrative dissolution if still not filed after delinquency (from ilsos.gov guide excerpt)

state_tax_on_llc.name: Personal property replacement income tax (LLC taxed as partnership)
state_tax_on_llc.applies: multi-member LLCs taxed as partnerships (and S corps); not single-member disregarded LLCs owned by individuals
state_tax_on_llc.notes: Entity-level tax on Illinois net income, on top of the members' 4.95% individual tax. LLCs taxed as C corps pay 2.5% replacement tax + 7% corporate income tax.

sources.title: Illinois DOR - Income Tax Rates

entity_level_taxes.notes: Applies to corporations including S corps; not verified today (ilsos.gov blocked)

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Partnerships and S corporations may elect the PTE tax at 4.95% of net income; Public Act 104-0453 removed the PTE tax expiration date.

personal_exemption.notes: $2,925 per exemption for 2026 (up from $2,850); +$1,000 if 65+ or blind; not allowed if federal AGI > $250,000 ($500,000 MFJ).

unemployment_2026.notes: Entry rate 3.350% includes 0.550% fund building rate; some NAICS sectors pay more (e.g. sector 56: 3.450%)

notable: S corps and partnership-taxed LLCs pay a 1.5% replacement tax at entity level, on top of the 4.95% individual tax (https://tax.illinois.gov/research/taxrates/income.html)
No standard deduction; only a $2,925 per-person exemption in 2026, phased out above $250,000 / $500,000 AGI (https://tax.illinois.gov/research/publications/bulletins/fy-2026-15.html)
PTE elective tax made permanent by Public Act 104-0453 (https://tax.illinois.gov/research/publications/bulletins/fy-2026-15.html)
No city income tax in Chicago or elsewhere in Illinois
